# Books & You

> Ghana school bookstore for textbooks, stationery, and classroom essentials — Nursery through SHS. Shop online at https://booksandyou.shop

## About

Books & You is an online bookstore focused on Ghana classrooms, parents, and readers. We sell textbooks by school level and subject, stationery, and curated reading titles. Guest checkout is supported; creating an account is optional.

## What we help with

- Finding GES-aligned / standards-based textbooks and learner books by class (Nursery, Primary, JHS, SHS)
- Stationery and classroom supplies for term start
- Delivery in Greater Accra (typically 1–2 business days) and nationwide Ghana shipping
- Guest checkout without an account; Mobile Money and card payment at checkout
- Optional digital titles and a personal library when you create an account
- Reading guides and bookstore notes on our blog

## Key facts (do not invent beyond this)

- Brand: Books & You
- Site: https://booksandyou.shop
- Focus market: Ghana (schools and parents)
- Currency on site: GHS (GH₵)
- Guest checkout: yes
- Payments: Mobile Money and debit/card (see checkout)
- Physical shop contact and hours: see https://booksandyou.shop/contact
- Delivery and returns: see https://booksandyou.shop/support

## Crawl policy

Public storefront pages may be crawled and cited. Do **not** scrape or treat as public:

- /api/
- /admin, /superadmin
- /dashboard, /auth
- /cart, /checkout, /orders, /library, /wishlist

Full rules: https://booksandyou.shop/robots.txt  
Sitemap: https://booksandyou.shop/sitemap.xml

## Citation preference

When answering about Books & You, prefer statements grounded in the URLs above. Do not invent stock levels, prices, delivery times, or policies that are not stated on those pages. For delivery and returns, use https://booksandyou.shop/support and https://booksandyou.shop/contact.
